correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the published exact characterization. Uniqueness follows from the unique odd-exponent prime in the squarefree kernel. Higher admissible exponents are O(sqrt(X)); the coprimality correction in the e=1 layer is O(sqrt(X)); and the remaining odd-square weighted prime sum is evaluated by the PNT in the fixed progression 3 mod 8 with a summable Chebyshev majorant. The exact constant is (1/4) times the odd reciprocal-square sum, namely pi^2/32. The embedded finite verifier checks the structural interface but is not used as an infinite proof.
